name: Relevance
description: The degree to which the response is relevant to the user's query or prompt.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant

name: Clarity
description: The clarity and coherence of the response, including grammar and sentence structure.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is very unclear and 5 is very clear

name: Depth
description: The depth and comprehensiveness of the response, including the level of detail and insight provided.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is superficial and 5 is deep and insightful

name: Engagement
description: The extent to which the response is engaging and interesting to the user.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is not engaging at all and 5 is highly engaging

name: Creativity
description: The creativity and originality of the response, including the use of novel ideas or perspectives.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is not creative and 5 is highly creative

name: Responsiveness
description: The degree to which the response directly addresses the user's needs or questions.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is not responsive at all and 5 is highly responsive

name: Accuracy
description: The accuracy and correctness of the information provided in the response.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is highly inaccurate and 5 is highly accurate
